selection: Eligible selected holdout paths only. First earliest historical termination in each primary outcome class; then earliest failure in any uncovered scene; fill remaining slots alternating earliest/latest failures, ties by job_id. Maximum six per family. Inventory also retains all raw-best paths and missing paths.
expansion: After the fixed 18-or-fewer pilot paths pass replay equivalence without errors, expand P1 and P2 to ALL nominal-body-eligible selected holdout paths. Never replace a pilot case. P3 uses the raw-best path of every same expanded task, including geometry rejects.
C4: Not preregistered; pitch-demand associations reported descriptively, no post-hoc additional tuning.
frozen: 5A kinematics, integration, Route, Geometry, map, body sphere, angle gain, limits, dt, goal tolerance and tracking-error threshold unchanged. Diagnostic loop is checked against the original track function and original records.
time_limit: Exactly 5A min(600,max(60,3*length/speed+30)); speed-dependent budget reported per replay. Wall guard remains 20 seconds per replay.
shortcut: One deterministic farthest-visible-vertex greedy pass using the original planning radius, no randomness or search. Derive from raw_best, never compare unrelated incumbents as a shortcut pair.
P0: T01-T08 mathematical expectations in tests and p0.py; no real-scene scan before all pass.
statistics: Per-scene counts first; paired changes include every replay, no success-only error means, no p-values or unseen-map generalization. Spearman associations are descriptive and omit undefined features explicitly.
storage: Historical full coordinates read in place. New per-step replay trace saved once outside repository. Public CSV has summaries and IDs only. No extra file hashes.
stop: Stop after P0-P3, report Go/Refine Evaluation/Pivot and open unmerged stacked PR. P4 development requires later researcher review.
